what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Australia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4181 Ukrainian refugees in Australia, 0.1% of all refugees from Ukraine.
Germany hosts the most Ukrainian refugees, followed by Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2014 to 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 559 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 7472, at the end of 2023; the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
These are year-end totals for Australia only, reported to UNHCR.
